original_implementation_notes: JSONNumber.swift reference reviewed; new bounded decimal storage and conversions written without copying upstream numeric implementation.
Native codec, Codable, Pointer, Patch and streaming are original implementations from the integrated contract, not automatically attributed to candidates.

Schema graph, explicit evaluator, exact sets/assertions and scalar format recognizers are original implementations from Draft 2020-12, RFC3986/3987/3339/3492/5321/5891/5892/5893/6531/6570/6901 and fixed Unicode13 data.

Private FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 is an original Swift implementation with checked cumulative production accounting, bounded scratch and inner cancellation. The separate trusted fixture tool mirrors its primitive core byte-for-byte; public_check verifies parity. No CryptoKit fallback or runtime dependency is introduced.

JSONHTML formatted rendering, original fixed CSS and shared strict-writer token classification are original Apache-2.0 code. No third-party renderer, browser numeric authority or runtime dependency is adapted.

CLI foundation, argv parser, POSIX adapters, prepaid bounded diagnostics and shared-meter package adapters are original Apache-2.0 Swift code. No legacy filter engine or jq source is copied. See Release1.4/Foundation.md for native test-harness reuse provenance.

Tests/Fixtures/CLI/NewCases.json is the byte-identical 111-case authored CLI briefing fixture, SHA-256 6f863f3e98d2dea12e59018e7cf3a074ae0ebee5f1ab950a651df72e5eb18a4c. Fixture expected JSON texts use native exact comparison, not a floating-point oracle. The query compiler/VM and lifetime ledger are original Apache-2.0 implementations; no legacy eager evaluator or jq implementation is copied.

JSONHTML typed annotations, iterative exact-path binding, static/interactive attachment and coherent JSONDocument span presentation are original Apache-2.0 code. No schema engine, third-party renderer, source archive or new dependency is adapted.

Structured forms/cards, finite prefix/preview staging, closed inline scanner, atomic mini-math MathML emitter, canonical PNG/JPEG header admission and line/media-bounded PDF pagination are original Apache-2.0 code. The approved structured concept informed the fixed CSS/JS; no demo Site content or external parser/renderer/codec engine is distributed.
policy: Record actual adaptations and retain applicable upstream copyrights and licenses. Reference inputs and comparison experiments are not distributed runtime dependencies.
original_notes: 1.4 C3 decimal magnitude, rational/quantization kernel, pull range and type-directed overloads are original Apache-2.0 code. The 738-case deterministic oracle uses Python integer/Fraction arithmetic; no jq/Rhoe arithmetic implementation was copied.

1.4 inherited CLI qualification fixtures are copied byte-for-byte: RhoePlatform/RhoeJSON pin 51d37acc137422065b07ebeb7e4ecdb2d02b99ee, 119 golden and 49 subset rows. Apache-2.0 license retained in Licenses/RhoeJSON-CLI-Fixtures-Apache-2.0.txt. PlanningDispositions labels are provisional, not evaluated successes. New explicit-stack CLI code is original; old eager JSONValue evaluator and arithmetic were not ported.

1.4 C4 immutable IR/function/pattern metadata, invocation closures/thunks, continuations, scalar string and format helpers, root-provenance paths and transactional mutation are original Apache-2.0 code. No eager upstream evaluator, Foundation regex or approximate arithmetic was copied.

1.4 C5 stream/offline-schema adapters, checked sink handoff, command help and consumers are original Apache-2.0 code. Five NewInputs fixtures are copied byte-for-byte from the maintainer CLI briefing pack 43f8819c57e3d93bc6f7cf561d2d111442e089f2973cb7c62e16e3bd3fd73d0d; these authored data fixtures introduce no runtime dependency. Missing provider helper prerequisites remain blocked rather than adapted or silently rewritten.

1.4 checked schema resource lookup and its missing/quota/cancellation/install regressions are original Apache-2.0 code. Supported app/framework/command layouts retain all nine official resource pins; no unbounded directory scan, fallback engine or external dependency is introduced.

1.5.1 restores 126 original Apache-2.0 test functions and qualification tools from Swift-JSON 1.2.1 (e8b687f822c577311156b13bf1d15c2d5620b84e), with file hashes and stable function identities in Qualification/Release1.5.1/Restoration.json. The diagnostic omission and Git-free provenance repairs are restored original code; current seven-product harness reconciliation and deterministic CLI identity are original contributions. No new upstream adaptation or dependency.
